subject: CYCLE-1 RESCOPE: compact content-addressed material-message envelope + reconstruction oracle
body: RESCOPE to avoid overlap. The broad message-board optimization lane is already owned by rnd-gen7-msgbus-opt-sol-db0810e5-2108, and package-drift/persistence compliance is already covered by rnd-gen7-msgpersist-sol-db0810e5-2108 plus Manager review. This lane now exclusively prototypes and tests a compact content-addressed material-message envelope: deterministic fact hashing, referential messages, idempotent duplicate suppression without erasing distinct authority events, artifact/digest fail-closed verification, supersession ordering, and state reconstruction. Cadence/liveness redesign is explicitly out of scope here. No production Git writes.

service.blocker: Published regression baseline is anchored to 633c75be while current main is db0810e5; process-only lane does not change product invariants.
